brief.en: Launches an explosive seed pod projectile at zombies

description.en: Baby Dragon Bruits launch explosive seed pod projectiles at zombies.
description.zh: 小暴君火龙果向僵尸投掷爆裂子弹。

chat.en: As one of the heads from a Dragon Bruit, as mentioned, you can never find out his personality.
chat.zh: 他是暴君火龙果留下的一颗头，如前文，你永远不会知道他是什么性格。

text.en: powered Baby Dragon Bruits apply poison to the projectiles
text.zh: 暗影形态的暴君火龙果会使子弹带毒
